name: Contour survey
description: A surveyor's sheet on a globe: height tints from the lowest bare ground to the highest, soft shading, contour lines every kilometre and a firm shoreline.

knobs.name: relief
knobs.label: Relief
knobs.meaning: How strongly slopes are shaded under the tints.

knobs.name: detail
knobs.label: Detail
knobs.meaning: Contour spacing: from every 2.5 km down to every 250 m.

degrade.says: Drawn at a third of full resolution.
Contour lines off (the shoreline goes with them).

lift: A faster device, a smaller globe, or stopping the spin would lift it.
